cv.title: Growth Analyst
summary: Growth marketing analyst with experience across paid acquisition reporting, retention analysis and lifecycle experimentation in synthetic fixture organisations.

bullets: Report paid acquisition performance across fixture channels and campaigns.
Maintain lifecycle dashboards for retention and reactivation cohorts.
Design and read out fixture A/B tests on onboarding messaging.
Consolidated multi-channel fixture spend reporting into one scheduled model.
Automated recurring campaign reporting for the marketing team.
